description: Run when asked what a wallet holds or is worth. One call instead of balance + tokens + history; spam is left out of the total. SOL balance, top tokens with USD values, estimated total, and recent activity in one answer. Example: {"wallet": "<address>"}. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/wallet.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

wallet.description: The wallet to sum up. The user's wallet address.

name: wallet
